name: oriel
description: Lets an AI assistant use the apps on your Windows PC by reading each window as text through UI Automation, instead of screenshots.
long_description:
oriel lists a window's controls as text lines with refs, acts on them through UI Automation (press, fill, select, scroll) without taking the mouse, and replies to every action with what changed. It uses the real keyboard and mouse only where an app has no accessible controls.

Password fields, the lock screen, UAC prompts and password managers are off limits.

This build isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may warn about it, and Smart App Control blocks it.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether the PC is locked, seconds since the user last touched it, and the foreground window.

tools.name: windows
tools.description: Visible windows, front first, dialogs included.

tools.name: tree
tools.description: Named or actionable elements of one window as text lines, with refs, values and states.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Elements of a window whose name contains a text, optionally of one type.

tools.name: invoke
tools.description: Press, toggle, select or expand an element, and reply with what changed.

tools.name: set
tools.description: Fill a text field (password fields are refused), and reply with what changed.

tools.name: text
tools.description: Text of a document or field.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait until a window or an element appears, or pause for some seconds.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll an element into view, or a container by a page or a line.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Pick an item by its text in a combo box, list, tab strip or menu.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click with the real mouse where there is no UI Automation action, such as a sheet's cells or a canvas.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Press the left mouse button at one point of a window and release it at another.

tools.name: window
tools.description: Minimise, maximise, restore, move or resize a window.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: A picture of one window, for what text can't show.

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Restore a window if minimised and bring it to the front.

tools.name: close
tools.description: Close a window (an app may still ask to save).

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Start a program, file, folder or URI, and reply with the new window's tree.

tools.name: keys
tools.description: Send keystrokes to a window, after checking that it is in front and the focus is not a password field.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run several actions in one call, in order, stopping at the first error.
